title: Opening apps
drDigitalIntro:
To open an app, click its icon in the dock along the bottom of the screen.
• Ten apps live there: Messages, Browser, Files, Mail, Settings, Photos, App Market, Calendar, Reminders and Notes.
• One click on an icon opens that app in its own window.
• These are the real apps — the same Files, Mail and Browser you will use for the rest of the course.
• Open any four of them and have a look around. Nothing you click can break anything.

playgroundTask.instructions: Open any 4 apps from the dock — pick whichever ones you like.

drDigitalSuccess: That is how you open apps — one click and go. You opened four of them.
drDigitalHint: Click any icon in the dock along the bottom of the desktop. Four different icons finishes the activity.
